paragraphs: R' Yohanan ben ha-Nizof (a Tanna) — [Shabbat 115b (115a in the linked edition)](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.115a.7).
And in [the Tosefta (Shabbat 14:2 in the linked edition)](https://www.sefaria.org/Tosefta_Shabbat.14.2).[^1][^2]

notes.text: The linked Bavli has Yochanan HaNazuf, without ben, in the story of the Aramaic translation of Job. Hyman gives Yochanan ben ha-Nizof and the locator 115b.
The linked Tosefta has Rabbi Yochanan with bracketed ben Nozef. Hyman points to the Tosefta without giving its chapter.
